svg.title: BACnet/IP: BVLC, NPDU, then the APDU
svg.desc: The readProperty request of frame 3 of iti_bacnet_test.pcap, 32 bits per row: the BVLC header (type 0x81, function 0x0a Original-Unicast-NPDU, length 17), the NPDU (version 1, control 0x04 expecting a reply), the APDU (type 0 Confirmed-REQ with flags 0, max segments and APDU size 0x05, invoke ID 1, service choice 12) and the service data, a context-tagged object identifier device 4194303 and property 75; BacnetPacket keeps the BvlcHeader, the Npdu and, inside it, the Apdu with its named service.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
